main.description: Start a resumable upload of arbitrary media content. Returns a TUS upload URL and a short-lived bearer token used to authenticate subsequent chunk requests (no DPoP required on chunks). The DID of the authenticated user is recorded against the upload; on completion a VOD processing task is enqueued.

size.description: Total size of the upload in bytes.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the content being uploaded (e.g. video/mp4).

filename.description: Optional filename hint to attach as upload metadata.

draftUri.description: Optional ats:// URI of a draft VOD created via place.stream.vod.createDraft. When supplied, the upload's processing fills that draft (rather than creating a new one), so the user can edit metadata while the upload runs and re-upload if it fails. The draft's origin_upload_id is set to this upload.

uploadUrl.description: Absolute URL to PATCH/HEAD per the TUS protocol.

uploadToken.description: Short-lived bearer token bound to this upload. Send as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' on TUS requests.

errors.name: UploadTooLarge
errors.description: The requested upload exceeds the server's maximum allowed size.

errors.name: UnsupportedMimeType
errors.description: The server does not accept this MIME type for upload.
